items.name: Garlic Bulb
items.description: Herbwives swear it draws poison from the blood.

items.name: Gnarling Ear
items.description: Proof of a kill. Sergeant Pike pays for these.

items.name: Hollowed Locket
items.description: A keepsake taken from one of the Hollowed. Someone in the village may know whose it was.

items.name: Crawler Venom Sac
items.description: Handle with care. The herbwife turns it into a cure for its own poison.

items.name: Imp Ember
items.description: Still warm. Bakers would kill for an oven coal like this.

items.name: Field Vole
items.description: Caught by Mofven. Small, but it keeps you going.

items.name: Wood Mouse
items.description: Caught by Mofven. Barely a mouthful.

items.name: Cave Rat
items.description: Caught by Mofven in the tunnels. Stringy, but it is meat.

items.name: Young Rabbit
items.description: Caught by Mofven. About as big as a grown owl can carry.

items.name: Hunter's Stew
items.description: Thick mutton stew. Slowly heals you.

items.name: Honey Cakes
items.description: Sweet, and they keep your legs going.

items.name: Garlic Broth
items.description: It stinks, and poison can barely touch you.

items.name: Venom Theriac
items.description: An apothecary's antidote. Cures poison at once and guards against it for a while.

items.name: Ember-Baked Pie
items.description: Baked over an imp's coal. Fills you with fury.

items.name: Tusk Marrow Soup
items.description: Rotfang marrow makes your skin tough as boot leather.
